main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean next-day excess return over XMR's mean daily return (bars with forecast > 0)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 (and top-third minus bottom-third > 0); reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return, top third by forecast minus bottom third

decided_by: The forecast-weighted mean excess return is > 0 with t >= 2 and the top-third minus bottom-third difference is > 0.
reading: Bars with forecast > 0 counted are those with a next-day return inside their window; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all 1-bar returns over all windows; the t of the weighted mean uses the weighted standard error sqrt(n/(n-1) * sum(w^2 (x-m)^2)) / sum(w); thirds are the floor(n/3) lowest and highest forecasts (stable sort); fewer than 100 such bars is reported as not observable.
